Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Vishal Dhagat

On The 15 th Of July, 2024
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 29202 of 2024
 Jimi Hamid
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh
 Appearance:
 Shri Jitendra Tiwari - Advocate.
 Shri G.S.Thakur - Govt. Advocate.
 Order

This is the first bail application filed under Section 482 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 on behalf of applicant for grant of anticipatory bail relating to Crime/FIR No.250/2023, registered at Police Station Hata District Damoh (M.P.) for the offence punishable under Section 420 of Indian Penal Code.

2. Heard learned counsel for parties.
3. Applicant is said to have changed debit card in ATM Centre.
He is also captured in camera.
He will be required for investigation.
4. Considering aforesaid circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is dismissed.
